title: fisherman at Dusk
provenance: Acquired by the late Mr. and Mrs. W. Gribble-Hale in 1969, subsequently inherited by their niece, Lady Vivian Harcourt-Thompson, who gifted it to the museum of the Maharaja of Ranthambore in 1987, before being sold at a private sale by the Maharani's estate to Meridian Fine Arts Auctioneers in 2022.
